title: Towel Shelf With Drying Rack 24.7-Inch Solid Brass 3-Tier Wall Mount | Matte White | Allied Brass | Traditional Bathroom Hardware | Allied Brass
description:
Need more towel storage without giving up floor space? This wall mount towel shelf with drying rack keeps folded towels organized while providing a built-in place to hang and air-dry towels—ideal for traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories in Matte White, which brings clean, fresh simplicity that brightens spaces and creates a light, airy bathroom atmosphere.

Highlights:
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Keep towels drying and ready to use with an integrated drying rack
- Achieve a streamlined look with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Coordinate with heritage bathroom fixtures using multiple designer finish options available
- Backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs & Installation:
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Dimensions (L x W x H): 24.7 in x 8.9 in x 10.4 in
- Projection: 3.5 in
- Weight: 5.6 lb
- Assembly: Some assembly required
- In the box: Towel shelf arms (3), back plate, and all installation hardware
